SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT KEP_SEQ FROM KEPCON.IF_C_FILE_UC WHERE DOC_TYPE = 'PODOWN' AND BUYER IN ('CNKOLO0001') AND IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY BUYER, KEY_NO, KEY_SEQ
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT KEY_NO AS PO_NO , KEY_SEQ AS PO_SEQ , F_SPLIT(DATA01,'^',1) AS STATUS , F_SPLIT(DATA01,'^',2) AS BUYER_ITEM_NO , to_number(F_SPLIT(DATA01,'^',3)) AS UNIT_PRICE , to_number(F_SPLIT(DATA01,'^',4)) AS ITEM_QTY , to_number(F_SPLIT(DATA01,'^',5)) AS ITEM_AMT , F_SPLIT(DATA01,'^',6) AS USER_DEPT , F_SPLIT(DATA01,'^',7) AS BUDGET_DEPT , F_SPLIT(DATA01,'^',8) AS ACCOUNT_TYPE , F_SPLIT(DATA01,'^',9) AS AGENT , F_SPLIT(DATA01,'^',10) AS AGENT_NM , F_SPLIT(DATA01,'^',11) AS PO_DATE , F_SPLIT(DATA01,'^',12) AS RD_DATE , F_SPLIT(DATA01,'^',13) AS LEGACY_PR_NO FROM KEPCON.IF_C_FILE_UC WHERE KEP_SEQ = '$G_RS.KEP_SEQ$'
UPDATE KEPCON.IF_C_FILE_UC SET IF_FLAG = 'Y' , IF_DATE = to_char(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , IF_TIME = to_char(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE KEP_SEQ = '$G_RS.KEP_SEQ$'
UPDATE KEPCON.IF_C_FILE_UC SET IF_FLAG = 'E' , IF_DATE = to_char(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , IF_TIME = to_char(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE KEP_SEQ = '$G_RS.KEP_SEQ$'
